subject: Launchpad Analytics - Marketplace renewal & private offer transition
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@launchpad.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@launchpad.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + marketplace private offer question

Hi Naomi,

Our annual commitment with Redwood is up for renewal in August. We love the performance gains we saw with dedicated capacity and are interested in moving the next term to a GCP Private Offer so we can simplify procurement and get consolidated invoicing.

High-level asks:
- 24-month term instead of 12 (stability for our budgeting)
- Capacity uplift from 2.0 to 3.5 V100-equivalent units (estimated peak)
- Staggered invoicing: 50% upfront, 25% in month 7, 25% in month 13 (our finance requires this cadence)
- Paperwork: can you provide a PO-ready PDF and a DocuSign link?

We can loop in our cloud broker (Markus) for private-offer setup. Let me know the next steps and any info you need from our side.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Platform
Launchpad Analytics
[Attachment: Launchpad_Renewal_Draft.xlsx]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@launchpad.ai>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace private offer question

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely support a GCP Private Offer and the staggered invoicing pattern you describe; a few notes and next steps below.

Summary of what we can do now:
- Term: 24 months — yes, we can provision that on a private offer.
- Capacity: we can set committed throughput equivalent to 3.5 units and provide burst capacity for peak windows.
- Staggered invoicing: supported as a billing arrangement tied to the private offer (we will reflect this in the PO).

Request from your side:
- Confirm whether the upfront 50% should be invoiced at contract signature or at the first billing cycle.
- Please confirm legal entity name and billing address for the PO.

Action items we will take this week:
- I will send a PO-ready PDF and a DocuSign envelope populated with the standard private-offer SOW (Dev will prepare).
- Marissa will coordinate with finance to map the staggered invoice schedule and any tax/withholding considerations for Switzerland (since Markus is involved).

Looping in Dev (product ops) and Marissa (marketplace billing). Markus + your procurement team are on cc so they have visibility.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales, EU
Redwood Inference
From: dev.patel@redwood.ai <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@launchpad.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace private offer question

Thanks Naomi / Sarah — I drafted the PO-ready artifacts and a revised SOW that calls out throughput, burst rules, and a migration window for the private-offer assignment. Key items in the draft (attached):
- Committed capacity: 3.5 units (monthly committed tokens converted to capacity units in the SOW)
- Burst: up to 5.0 equivalent units for 72 hours per month on a first-come basis
- Term start: on signature; finance can mark the first invoice as "initial payment" if you prefer signature-triggered billing
- SLA / fallback: we include an automatic fallback to hosted capacity (with rate limits) if private-offer capacity is exhausted to preserve critical paths

I attached: GCP_PrivateOffer_SOW_v3.docx and Launchpad_PO_Draft_2027-06.pdf.

If procurement wants the 50% billed after signature, we can set the invoice milestone accordingly. Marissa, can you confirm how tax handling looks for a Swiss broker invoice?

- Dev
[Attachments: GCP_PrivateOffer_SOW_v3.docx; Launchpad_PO_Draft_2027-06.pdf]
From: Markus Bieri <markus@cloudbroker.ch>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@launchpad.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:21:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace private offer question

Hi all — Markus from CloudBroker here. We can help with the GCP private-offer setup. A few logistics from the broker side:

- GCP requires the private offer to match the billing entity; please confirm Launchpad's billing entity exact name and VAT/UID (we need this for the private offer).
- For staggered invoices requested by Launchpad, we usually create milestones tied to payment schedule in the private-offer metadata and route the invoices back to the broker or directly to Launchpad depending on preference.
- I reviewed the SOW and suggest a minor change to the billing code mapping so the committed units map to a single SKU for simpler reconciliation. Happy to patch the draft and re-upload.

Markus
CloudBroker AG
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@launchpad.ai, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace private offer question

Hi Sarah / Procurement —

Thanks for the details. We can accommodate the 50% at signature milestone. To proceed I'll need:
- Final billing entity name and VAT number (for PO)
- Confirmation that Launchpad signs the PO and the private-offer SOW through DocuSign (we'll send the envelope)
- Any internal PO number to include on the invoice

Once we have those, Naomi/Dev will finalize the SOW and I'll kick off the marketplace paperwork with GCP. Expect the DocuSign envelope by EOD tomorrow after we apply Markus's SKU mapping change.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Finance lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Guide.pdf]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@launchpad.ai>, procurement@launchpad.ai
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + marketplace private offer question

Sarah — quick note to confirm next steps and deliverables:

1) Launchpad to confirm billing entity + VAT + PO number (if applicable).
2) CloudBroker (Markus) will produce a small SKU mapping adjustment — Dev will merge and re-attach SOW.
3) Marissa will send DocuSign envelope with the PO & SOW for 50% signature milestone.
4) Once signed, GCP private-offer creation will be submitted and we will share the private offer ID and invoicing cadence (we aim for 48-hour turnaround after signature).

I'll remain the exec owner — looping Jonas for any escalation on marketplace timelines. If procurement needs a different split (e.g., 60/20/20), let us know within 48 hours so we can adjust the envelope.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales, EU
Redwood Inference

[DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/launchpad-PO-2027]
